$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

id.description: Scene id; also the ?scene= URL value.

grid.description: Size of one grid cell in metres.

target.description: Point the camera looks at, metres.

at.description: Position in grid cells (x, y, z), snapped to SCENE_SNAP_STEP.

scale.description: Stretch along the piece’s own x, y, z (e.g. a 2 m floor tile scaled 5× is 10 m).

properties.description: World properties of the piece over the level material, e.g. { "climbable": "ivy" } or a wooden material.

material.description: Material preset id (a material content entry).

absorbency.description: The most wetness it can hold (nothing soaks in … fully absorbent); water raises wetness no higher, 0 … 1.

freezePoint.description: Temperature at or below which it freezes, °C.

fragile.description: Impact energy that breaks it, J.

density.description: Density, kg/m³; below 1000 it floats in water.

climbable.description: Climbing grade: none, ladder, rope, ivy (easy), rough (needs a climber), sheer (needs a tool).

liftable.description: Can be picked up and carried.

remoteActuatable.description: Can be operated from a distance by magic (remote actuation).

hideable.description: An actor can hide in or behind it.

transparent.description: Light and sight pass through it.

impactAbsorb.description: Fraction of impact energy it absorbs, 0 … 1.

liquid.description: A liquid: it pours, puddles and can have a water surface.

flammableGas.description: A gas that ignites (flares or explodes) when fire reaches it.

extinguishable.description: A fire or light source that water, force or an interaction puts out.

windResistance.description: Force of one gust, blast or kick that blows its flame out, N·s.

flameRadius.description: Radius around its centre in which its flame burns a creature that touches it, m (0 = enclosed: a lantern never burns passers-by). Leave it off a loose burning object: that burns within its own radius plus the hazard reach.

waterSurface.description: Top surface of a body of liquid: cold freezes it into walkable ice (needs a liquid material).

unstable.description: Force of one push, blast or quake that topples it, J.

suspended.description: Hangs from its support; falls when the support breaks, burns or is cut.

support.description: Entity a suspended object hangs from (0 = none); set when the level spawns.

breakable.description: A single hit at or above its toughness for that kind of hit breaks it.

blunt.description: Blunt hit energy that breaks it, J.

slash.description: Slash hit energy that breaks it, J.

pierce.description: Pierce hit energy that breaks it, J.

force.description: Force (blast, quake, boulder) energy that breaks it, J.

toughness.description: Per kind of hit, the single-hit energy that breaks a breakable object; a kind left out never does.

bashable.description: A shield bash or kick shoves it (or breaks it when breakable).

cuttable.description: Slash or pierce damage severs it.

shootable.description: Projectile impulse that fires its signal, N·s.

softAnchor.description: Rope arrows and hooks embed in it.

surfaceHardness.description: Footstep loudness and whether arrows stick (soft, medium) or ricochet (hard).

chargeActivated.description: Stored charge at which the mechanism fires.

lightActivated.description: Light level on it at which the mechanism fires.

hidden.description: Not perceivable or targetable until revealed.

trapped.description: Interacting with it triggers its trap unless disarmed first (needs a trap).

trap.description: Trap definition id a trapped object triggers.

container.description: Holds items (contents live in the e18 container component).

remains.description: Inert skeletal or corpse remains that summoning can raise.

noiseMultiplier.description: Multiplier on its wearer's noise; an actor's is the product of its equipment's.

ledges.description: Ledge overrides, applied in order (a later one wins over an earlier one).

side.description: Top edge on this side of the piece (its own axes, before yaw); omit for every side.

part.description: Index of the part in the kit piece; omit for every part.

ledge.description: false: never a ledge (decoration); true: always a ledge (the whole edge).

breakable.description: Makes the piece breakable, e.g. a cracked wall the knight can smash (mw-e03.11).

profile.description: Breakable profile: resistances, debris, break loudness.

contents.description: Props it spills when it breaks (props with a body; mw-e03.39).

reveals.description: Passage it opens when it breaks: names the passageRevealed event (nav, quests).

id.description: Name of the spawn, unique in the scene (e.g. player-start).

at.description: Position in grid cells (x, y, z), snapped to SCENE_SNAP_STEP.

prop.description: Prop to spawn; without one the spawn is a marker.

tags.description: Free-form tags for systems and tools.

interact.description: Makes the spawned entity interactable: its affordances (mw-e02.5).

label.description: Prompt text; defaults to the verb (e.g. "Pull").

hold.description: Seconds Interact must be held; 0 or omitted fires on press.

requires.description: Every one must hold for the actor to use it (else shown greyed with the reason).

item.description: Item id the actor must carry (a key).

reason.description: Shown while unavailable, e.g. "Locked — needs Iron Key".

affordances.description: In priority order: Interact uses the first one the actor can.

anchor.description: Focus point relative to the entity, metres; defaults to [0, 1, 0].

radius.description: Bounding radius of the focus point, metres.

targetable.description: Makes the spawned entity a lock-on target with this profile (mw-e02.16).

item.description: Places an item here as a world item the player can take, drop and throw (mw-e17.7).

count.description: Units in the one world item (a pile of arrows); default 1.

creature.description: Creature to spawn here (mw-e12.4); faces the spawn’s yaw.

faction.description: Faction the spawned creature joins instead of its definition’s (needs creature).

patrol.description: Patrol route for the spawned creature: waypoints in grid cells, walked in order (needs creature; AI, e11, walks it).

items.description: Position in grid cells (x, y, z), snapped to SCENE_SNAP_STEP.

routine.description: Routes the spawned creature walks (mw-e11.9): the first whose window holds the hour runs (needs creature; not with patrol).

hours.description: From and to, hours of the day (wraps past midnight when from > to); omit for always.

leash.description: Ties the spawned creature to a post (mw-e01.17): in Combat it chases only this far from the post, then searches and walks home (needs creature).

radius.description: Metres from the post, measured on the level, past which a chase ends.

post.description: The post, grid cells; absent = the spawn point.

repopulate.description: Opts the spawned creature in to returning after it is killed (mw-ju8.29): it is spawned fresh at its origin when the scene next loads, or at once when the player is out of sight and far away. Not for bosses or gatekeepers (needs creature).

afterDays.description: World days after the kill before the creature returns; 1 = once the player has slept through a night.

presence.description: The spawn is only there during these phases of the day (mw-ju8.14, mw-e27.12): its creature is not spawned and its `interact` is switched off in any other phase, and both come and go as the clock crosses a phase boundary while the player is in the scene.

phases.description: Ids of the clock phases (time.phase: dawn, day, dusk, night) the spawn is there for.

carries.description: What the spawned creature carries and drops where it dies, as world items (mw-e01.5), e.g. the slice skeleton’s key (needs creature).

properties.description: World properties of the spawned entity, e.g. a torch: { "burning": true, "fuel": 3600 } (mw-e03.37). A spawn with properties is placed in the sim, so the light field and stimuli reach it.

material.description: Material preset id (a material content entry).

absorbency.description: The most wetness it can hold (nothing soaks in … fully absorbent); water raises wetness no higher, 0 … 1.

freezePoint.description: Temperature at or below which it freezes, °C.

fragile.description: Impact energy that breaks it, J.

density.description: Density, kg/m³; below 1000 it floats in water.

liftable.description: Can be picked up and carried.

hideable.description: An actor can hide in or behind it.

transparent.description: Light and sight pass through it.

flammableGas.description: A gas that ignites (flares or explodes) when fire reaches it.

extinguishable.description: A fire or light source that water, force or an interaction puts out.

windResistance.description: Force of one gust, blast or kick that blows its flame out, N·s.

waterSurface.description: Top surface of a body of liquid: cold freezes it into walkable ice (needs a liquid material).

unstable.description: Force of one push, blast or quake that topples it, J.

support.description: Entity a suspended object hangs from (0 = none); set when the level spawns.

breakable.description: A single hit at or above its toughness for that kind of hit breaks it.

blunt.description: Blunt hit energy that breaks it, J.

slash.description: Slash hit energy that breaks it, J.

pierce.description: Pierce hit energy that breaks it, J.

force.description: Force (blast, quake, boulder) energy that breaks it, J.

bashable.description: A shield bash or kick shoves it (or breaks it when breakable).

cuttable.description: Slash or pierce damage severs it.

softAnchor.description: Rope arrows and hooks embed in it.

surfaceHardness.description: Footstep loudness and whether arrows stick (soft, medium) or ricochet (hard).

chargeActivated.description: Stored charge at which the mechanism fires.

lightActivated.description: Light level on it at which the mechanism fires.

hidden.description: Not perceivable or targetable until revealed.

trapped.description: Interacting with it triggers its trap unless disarmed first (needs a trap).

trap.description: Trap definition id a trapped object triggers.

container.description: Holds items (contents live in the e18 container component).

remains.description: Inert skeletal or corpse remains that summoning can raise.

noiseMultiplier.description: Multiplier on its wearer's noise; an actor's is the product of its equipment's.

questCritical.description: The quest needs this world object (a statue part, a counterweight; mw-e17.14): it must name a `recovery` anchor, because it is carried physically and can be dropped, thrown or lost (ADR-0003).

recovery.description: Where the object returns to, grid cells (the middle of its base), if it ends up below the scene or out of bounds; `object.recovered` is emitted (mw-e17.14).

breakable.description: Makes the spawned entity breakable, e.g. a pot that spills its contents (mw-e03.11).

profile.description: Breakable profile: resistances, debris, break loudness.

contents.description: Props it spills when it breaks (props with a body; mw-e03.39).

reveals.description: Passage it opens when it breaks: names the passageRevealed event (nav, quests).

door.description: Makes the spawned entity a door: profile, lock and starting state (mw-e03.18).

profile.description: Door profile: kind, size, speed, material, what it shuts out.

lock.description: The lock it carries: what keys, picks and spells get past.

locked.description: Starts locked; defaults to true when it has a lock (needs one).

state.description: How it starts: closed, open or jammed.

hinge.description: Hinged and trapdoor: the side the hinge is on (−x or +x before yaw); sliding: the side it slides to.

swing.description: Hinged: swings towards +z (forward) or −z (back) before yaw.

switch.description: Makes the spawned entity a lever, button, crank or wheel (mw-e03.18).

positions.description: Positions it steps through (crank and wheel; a lever has 2, a button none).

plate.description: Makes the spawned entity a pressure plate that weighs what rests on it (mw-e03.19).

minWeight.description: Lightest total weight that turns it on, kg.

maxWeight.description: Heaviest total weight that keeps it on, kg; absent: no ceiling (too heavy fails).

hysteresis.description: Margin, kg, by which the window widens once it is on, so a jittering load holds.

mode.description: momentary follows its load; latching stays on until a signal resets it.

armSeconds.description: Seconds the load must stay in the window before it turns on.

hidden.description: The trap variant: nothing to see or prompt; wire it to trap signals.

rope.description: Makes the spawned entity a cuttable rope hanging down from its position (mw-e05.13).

length.description: How far it hangs straight down, metres (or give `to`).

to.description: Its other anchor, grid cells (or give `length`).

support.description: Gives it hit points and a load rating (mw-e03.13): see the support fields.

rating.description: Heaviest load its span carries, kg: what hangs from it and rests on that. Over it, the weakest rope of the span snaps. Omit: never overloads.

resistances.description: Share of each kind of hit it ignores; a kind left out is 0.

pierce.description: Share of pierce damage ignored (1: a chain).

span.description: Ropes of a scene with the same span share one load and fail together (a bridge’s two ropes); what hangs from one hangs from the span.

bridge.description: Makes the spawn one end of a rope bridge (mw-e03.13): two support ropes and their planks, hung level from the spawn to `to`.

to.description: The far end, grid cells: level with the spawn and along x or z, so a bridge runs straight.

planks.description: How many planks, evenly spaced from end to end.

plank.description: The plank prop: its first size axis is the bridge’s width.

rating.description: Heaviest load the bridge carries, kg: planks, what rests on them, and who walks.

resistances.description: Share of each kind of hit its two ropes ignore.

pierce.description: Share of pierce damage ignored (1: a chain).

width.description: Distance between the two ropes, metres: the plank prop’s width.

suspendedFrom.description: Spawn id of the rope this movable prop hangs from (mw-e05.13): it is held in place until the rope is cut or burnt, then falls.

lightSource.description: Makes the spawned entity a light source that can be put out and relit (mw-e03.16).

variant.description: Prefab: its fuel, light, ignition point and how much wind it takes to blow it out.

unlit.description: Starts dark; heat lights it (default false).

infiniteFuel.description: Never runs out of fuel while lit (default false).

tint.description: Colour of its rendered light, [r, g, b] 0–1 (mw-ju8.43); the prefab default (flame or lamp) when absent. Looks only: the sim light level is unchanged.

impactSwitch.description: Makes the spawned entity an impact switch that distant hits and spells trigger (mw-e03.20).

variant.description: Prefab: bullseye (pierce, small zone), bell (any impact, rings), crystal (charge or light), counterweight (slash, or released by its rope), target (any projectile at or above the spawn’s `shootable` impulse, latching).

minEnergy.description: Least energy that counts, J (the delivered amount for an element).

radius.description: Radius of the hit zone, metres.

mode.description: momentary stays on for holdSeconds after the last hit; latching until reset.

loudness.description: Noise made when struck, dB at 1 m; null for silent.

beamEmitter.description: Makes the spawned entity a light beam emitter (mw-e03.17).

kind.description: Prefab: sets default strength and reach.

direction.description: Direction it shines along (any non-zero vector).

optic.description: Makes the spawned entity a mirror, lens or pane for light beams (mw-e03.17).

kind.description: mirror bounces, lens focuses, pane tints.

normal.description: Direction its face points (any non-zero vector).

tint.description: What it lets through of each colour (default all).

lightReceiver.description: Makes the spawned entity a light receiver that beams switch on (mw-e03.17).

threshold.description: Intensity at or above which it counts.

dwellSeconds.description: Seconds it must be held before it turns on.

filter.description: Only light of about this colour counts (default any).

mode.description: momentary goes off with the light; latching until a signal resets it.

container.description: Makes the spawned entity a lootable container: loot table, contents and lock (mw-e18.3).

loot.description: Loot table rolled into it the first time it is opened (once; saves keep the result).

contents.description: What it holds from the start, before any roll.

item.description: An item it holds from the start.

lock.description: The lock it carries: unlocked and picked like a door’s (mw-e03.18).

locked.description: Starts locked; defaults to true when it has a lock (needs one).

waypoints.description: Named points patrol routes walk through (mw-e11.9).

id.description: Name of the waypoint, unique in the scene, e.g. yard-gate.

at.description: Position in grid cells (x, y, z), snapped to SCENE_SNAP_STEP.

dwellS.description: Seconds a guard stands here; default: the follow-route step’s dwellS (a post holds forever).

look.description: Direction it faces while it stands here, degrees: 0 faces +z, 90 faces +x.

scanArc.description: Degrees it sweeps its gaze across, centred on look, while it stands here.

scanS.description: Seconds one full sweep of the scan arc takes (there and back).

idle.description: Idle action cue played on arrival (e.g. guard-lean, guard-warm-hands, guard-check-door).

routes.description: Patrol routes and guard posts over the waypoints (mw-e11.9).

id.description: Name of the route, unique in the scene, e.g. yard-loop.

kind.description: loop, ping-pong, random (weighted graph) or post.

waypoints.description: Waypoint ids in walking order (random: the graph’s waypoints, each once).

links.description: Random routes only: the weighted ways between its waypoints.

weight.description: Relative chance of taking this way; default 1.

light.description: Static lighting: ambient level, ambient zones, directional lights (mw-e03.37).

ambient.description: Ambient level wherever no ambient zone applies, 0–1.

ambientZones.description: Boxes with their own ambient level; later zones win where they overlap.

id.description: Name of the zone, e.g. moonlit-yard.

max.description: Upper corner, grid cells; above min on every axis.

directional.description: Directional lights (moon, sun); the brightest is the rendered key light.

id.description: Name of the light, e.g. moon.

direction.description: Direction the light travels, e.g. [0, -1, 0] straight down.

reach.description: How far back towards the light a position must be clear to receive it, metres.

timeOfDay.description: Day and night look of the rendered light, following the game clock (mw-ju8.43).

minute.description: Minute of the day it applies at, 0–1439.

directional.description: Rendered level of the key light (sun or moon), 0–1.

signals.description: Signal graphs wiring its switches, volumes and doors (mw-e03.18).

bindings.description: Binding name → spawn id, for names that are not themselves spawn ids.

checkpoints.description: Volume nodes of the graph that are checkpoints: entering one requests an autosave (mw-e30.5).

acoustics.description: Rooms, portals and partitions for sound propagation (mw-e09.3).

id.description: Name of the room, unique in the scene, e.g. guard-room.

max.description: Upper corner, grid cells; above min on every axis.

id.description: Name of the portal, unique in the scene, e.g. guard-room-door.

prefixItems.description: A room id of this scene, or "outside".
A room id of this scene, or "outside".

rooms.description: The two rooms it joins (one may be "outside").

at.description: Its middle, grid cells: where a listener on the far side hears a sound come from.

door.description: Spawn id of the door in it; its state (open, ajar, closed) sets the loss.

partitions.description: Materials of partitions between touching rooms; the rest use the tuning default.

material.description: Material id of what separates them; its wall or floor gain comes from the stealth tuning.

environment.description: Outdoor look: sky colour, distance fog and a painted backdrop (mw-ju8.1).

fog.description: Distance fog that blends the level into the backdrop.

far.description: Distance where the fog is solid, m.

backdrop.description: Painted backdrop layer behind the level.

image.description: Image path under the backdrop folder (assets/_incoming in dev).

bearing.description: Compass direction the card is centred on, degrees: 0 faces +z, 90 faces +x.

arc.description: How much of the horizon the card spans, degrees; its height follows the image.

radius.description: Distance from the camera, m; must stay inside the camera far plane.

centreY.description: Height of the image centre above the camera plane, m.

follow.description: Share of the camera movement the card follows: 1 never parallaxes, 0 stays put.

regions.description: Tagged boxes, e.g. a river (mw-ju8.1); data only until a system reads them.

id.description: Name of the region, unique in the scene, e.g. river.

max.description: Upper corner, grid cells; above min on every axis.

surfaces.description: Boxes tagged with a footstep surface, e.g. carpet on a wooden floor (mw-e09.4).

id.description: Name of the surface region, unique in the scene, e.g. hall-carpet.

max.description: Upper corner, grid cells; above min on every axis.

surface.description: The footstep surface (audio bible §7.3) of everything inside, e.g. carpet.

priority.description: Where boxes overlap, the higher priority wins; the first listed wins a tie.

transitions.description: Volumes that lead to another scene, and where the player arrives (mw-e01.11).

id.description: Name of the transition, unique in the scene, e.g. north-gate.

min.description: Lower corner of the volume, grid cells.

max.description: Upper corner of the volume, grid cells; above min on every axis.

spawn.description: The spawn of that scene the player arrives at; its yaw is the way the player faces.

follow.description: Companions flagged to follow travel with the player through it (none exist yet).

ambience.description: Ambience zones placed over regions of the scene or all of it (mw-e28.13).

zone.description: The ambience zone that plays here.

region.description: Id of one of the scene’s regions; leave out to cover the whole scene.
